profile.headline: Software Engineer at Attentive
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Full Stack Web Developer currently working in Python, Typescript, and Java. Utilizes honed interpersonal skills to collaborate within teams, pair program, and stimulate personal growth through networking. Proven aptitude for long and short-term project management.

positions.title: Solutions Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
ETL Reporting:
  • Developed and maintained a Python script to extract client event data and package into csvs for ingestion.
  • Integrate with AWS s3 and paramiko to send files, Datadog to report on performance and errors, and Airflow to schedule runs. 
API Development:
  • Built features for our team's Java API, which allows users to make DB updates via interface.
  • Designed protos to standardize requests, used grpc and jdbi to communicate between frontend, backend, and DB.
Tag Management:
  • Customized Typescript configurations to properly capture event data from client sites.
  • Built new async features which allow for more thorough data collection when site load is delayed.

positions.title: Manager - Service and Support
positions.description:
•	Oversaw performance of 30 customer service agents and directly managed 11 employees. Facilitated promotion of 10 high performing employees into new roles. 
•	Used Contacts Per Order data to project staffing and budget and introduce seasonal hiring. 
•	Developed a manager-report communication strategy that promoted transparency and clear goals, contributing to a 25% increase in Productivity. 
•	Interviewed and made all final decisions on team hiring and candidate evaluation.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:

•	Developed training materials for new hires and ran new hire training.  
•	Created quality rubric and coached graders toward consistency and fairness.
•	Planned Cyber Monday event including sign up, scheduling, and training for over 100 staff.

positions.title: Customer Experience Ninja
positions.description:
•	Delivered exemplary customer service through phone, chat, and email.
•	Performed fraud reviews to examine validity of orders based on cost, IP, velocity, contents, destination, and other factors.

positions.title: Tape Op/Board Op
positions.description:

•	Edited self-contained audio segments under pressure of minimal time window.  
•	Fact-checked and edited on-air copy for over 100 radio stations.

The MVP Award is given to the individual who received an overwhelming number of nominations and/or who Leadership determines has made significant contributions to the organization.

projects.title: Shop Equal
projects.description: Empowering a community means supporting the livelihoods of the people in that community. Shop Equal is a centralized interface designed to empower the Black community by directing users to Black owned businesses. Our API is open source and well-documented and our goal is to develop and share an immense list of Black owned businesses that other developers can use in their projects. Shop Equal was developed during a hackathon in collaboration with Valentine Maillard, Rashan Smith, Kriti Rai, and Kah Yap. Design credit goes to Shelley Liang.

projects.title: Fantasy Football Auction Draft Simulator
projects.description:
Simulate different auction draft scenarios against automated opponents to test different strategies.

- Uploaded CSV data to PostgresQL DB to populate over 500 players
- Applied Redux to make state accessible to four layers of React components
- Developed Javascript algorithms to automate the decisions of virtual fantasy opponents
